stats_by_spread.financing_note: S-21 (2026-09-11): every figure in this file is computed with ZERO cost of leverage, because LEAN charges none - DefaultBrokerageModel.GetMarginInterestRateModel returns MarginInterestRateModel.Null, whose ApplyMarginInterestRate is an empty method body, and InteractiveBrokersBrokerageModel does not override it. This book carries 1.50x gross against 1.00x of equity, i.e. a debit balance on 83.3% of sessions averaging 0.493x of equity, and it has never paid a cent of interest on it. Charged at IBKR Pro's published tiers on the historical effective fed funds rate (FRED DFF), the 0 bp column becomes 23.087% / 0.939 / DD 24.1% (run 20260911T194431Z, -1.316 CAR) and the 2 bp column becomes 21.745% / 0.882 / 25.4% (run 20260911T195453Z, -1.323). The correction is out-of-sample weighted more than two to one: IS 2012-2019 16.791% against 17.698% (-0.907), OOS 2020-2026 30.774% against 32.801% (-2.027), because the benchmark went from ~0.1% to 5% and 82% of the sample's total interest was incurred in 2023-2026. At today's 3.63% benchmark the forward-looking drag is about 2.0 CAR points a year, not 1.3. About half is the irreducible cost of money (benchmark-only: 0.56 of 1.11 simple points) and half is the broker's markup, which a larger account pays less of. THIS IS NOT A DEFECT AND NOT A PROMOTABLE COLUMN: it is a real cost the paper account has been paying since its first fill, there is nothing wrong with the runner, and the only thing it corrects is the expectation. S1_FINANCING defaults off so the whole ledger stays on one scale (S-17's precedent with S1_SLIPPAGE_BPS), and scripts/evaluate.py REFUSES any run recorded with S1_FINANCING=on as not comparable rather than judging it against these columns. Reproduce with scripts/sweep_s21.py --probe --report.
stats_by_spread.note: S-18: a candidate charged a spread is not measurable against a champion row that paid none - LEAN charges no spread by default (S-17: DefaultBrokerageModel returns NullSlippageModel) and the bias runs toward whichever book trades most. scripts/evaluate.py picks the column matching the candidate's own S1_SLIPPAGE_BPS, which scripts/backtest.py now records with every run; a run at a spread with no matching column is refused as not comparable rather than judged against the wrong one. The headline 'stats' above stay the 0 bp column so the whole ledger remains one scale, but the promotion below was decided on the 2.0 column. The retired S-12 champion's two columns, for reference: 0 bp 4,735 orders / 24.404% / 0.921 / 25.100% / 0.170 std / 23.044% PSR / $45,695.46 (run 20260909T042431Z), 2 bp 4,723 / 22.926% / 0.865 / 29.200% / $41,885.99 (run 20260911T125421Z).

criteria.note: Owner decision 2026-09-09: return-first. A candidate must beat the champion on CAR, may be at most 0.03 Sharpe below it, may not have a drawdown more than 1 point worse than the champion's, and never above 35% absolute. Promote only through scripts/evaluate.py; shelf-not-spike and the 'not promotable' tag still apply. S-18 adds one rule that is about measurement rather than risk: compare at the same cost model (stats_by_spread above).

note: S-18 retired two of the strategy's original mechanisms, each on a measurement and neither on preference. (1) The 3x proxies (UPRO/TQQQ/TMF for SPY/QQQ/TLT): IBKR charges 0.333 of margin per unit of economic exposure on a 3x ETF against 0.5 on an ordinary one, so their whole contribution was that 2.25x of exposure fitted inside the 0.75 margin budget - room, not edge (S-15 e: -1.28 CAR for worse Sharpe, worse drawdown and $20k more commission). (2) The step drawdown breaker: S-15 priced it at -1.59 CAR (paired -0.51 bps/day, t -1.93, OOS t -2.35) for 2.1 points of drawdown, the only near-significant statistic in that attribution and against the switch, and S-16 showed it is strictly harmful in an unlevered book (0.80 budget: shipped 24.551 / DD 25.5, widened 25.333 / DD 25.0, off 25.903 / DD 25.1) - S-8's re-arming problem, a step breaker that flattens at -25% sells the bottom and the cooldown holds the book out of the recovery. THE CASE IS NOT MORE RETURN. Full period at 0 bp the two books are a dead heat: 24.403% vs 24.404%, paired -0.00 bps/day at t -0.00 on 3,689 sessions; at 2 bp it is +0.142 CAR at +0.05 bps/day, t +0.12. The case is the same return carried with less risk and less cost: Sharpe 0.994 vs 0.921, realized vol 0.155 vs 0.170, drawdown 23.7 vs 25.1 at 0 bp and 25.0 vs 29.2 at 2 bp, PSR 33.2 vs 23.0, fees $27.2k vs $45.7k, and economic exposure 1.50x against 2.25x. Why it is promoted now when S-16 refused it by 0.001 CAR points: that margin existed only at exactly zero spread, which is LEAN's default rather than a choice, and the crossover between the two books is at ~0.03 bp against a half-cent tick worth 0.27 bp on XLK, 0.71 on TQQQ and 0.77 on XLE - the hard floor of a real fill is an order of magnitude past it (S-17). Sub-periods (S-18, the halves S-12 itself was promoted on), candidate vs champion: IS 2012-2019 at 0 bp 17.698% / 0.911 / DD 23.7 against 19.180% / 0.884 / 25.1, i.e. -1.48 CAR (paired -0.50 bps/day, t -1.25) but better Sharpe and 1.4 fewer points of drawdown; OOS 2020-2026 at 0 bp 32.801% / 1.108 / 23.3 against 30.863% / 0.985 / 22.6, i.e. +1.94 CAR (+0.58 bps/day, t +0.87). At 2 bp: IS 16.349 vs 17.509 (DD 25.0 vs 29.2), OOS 31.477 vs 29.621. So the return difference is out-of-sample weighted and the risk difference holds in both halves; nothing in the comparison reaches |t| = 2, which the promotion does not hide. Reproduce with: py -3.11 scripts/backtest.py s1_momo (no env vars) -> 5,128 orders, 24.403%, 0.994, 23.700%, $27,199.76, OrderListHash a6d6224ce9c70091e5bfa8e96f046bf3. I-1 deploy gate re-run after the change: scripts/compare_orders.py passes 3,689/3,689 dates, 5,021 orders on both sides, and paper_trade.py --mock --dry-run plans XLE/XLK/IWM at 1.50x gross with margin 0.75. Live consequence to expect on the next 15:45 ET paper session: the book rotates out of TQQQ into unlevered names. The no-trade band was measured on this book and NOT changed: 0.03 is worth +0.064 CAR at 0 bp and +0.103 at 2 bp (t +0.58 / +0.94), a fifth of what S-17 measured on the 3x champion, so the shipped 0.01 stands. Open and deliberately not taken here: the unlevered book frees risk that margin_budget can buy back (S-16: 0.78 / 0.80 / 0.82 give 25.307 / 25.903 / 26.474 at rising Sharpe), which is the owner's Reg-T buffer question in BLOCKERS.md - this promotion leaves the budget at 0.75 and makes that question worth more, not less.
